decision: Preserve and bind current canonical README. Its delta is only upper planning-link path correction plus lower planning-index row. Linked proposals are reference-only map/activity composition drafts, not new U08 policy.
source_read_scope: Upper proposal scope/new-values/normal and reward activity allocation sections
Lower proposal introduction, gameplay boundaries, allocation, boss/after-clear activity proposal and final scope
nonimpact: No U08 relic arithmetic, per-copy ownership, numeric source, schema, persistence, catalyst or public command contract changes. Current product source and all actual test inputs remain unchanged; no product/performance rerun caused by this documentary delta.
future_scope: Map composition and activity distribution belong to future roadmap/map/content review. New proposed counts/weights and final-room layout are not adopted as canonical and individual final-boss implementation remains excluded.
reference_binding: Bind this review and immutable snapshots as evidence of what was read. Do not promote linked live proposal documents into U08 current canonical requirements. Canonical README currentness itself remains required.
